features.name: heimdall
features.purpose: Deterministic reconciler kernel supervising durable watchers; kinds register into it in-tree.

features.name: hosted-review-sitter
features.purpose: Watches explicitly enrolled hosted reviews, journals decisions and approvals, and gates branch updates, policy-bound fixes, and merges.

features.name: heimdall-objective
features.purpose: Objective watcher kind with structured contracts, orchestration roles, plan revisions, acceptance checks, and landing evidence in a fork-owned store.

features.name: worktree-groups
features.purpose: Lets a worktree join a project group independently of its repo's own group membership, so cross-repo worktrees can share a sidebar section.

features.name: native-chat-relay
features.purpose: Pages and live-tails native-chat transcripts for local agent sessions, with older-history paging, a live-session state machine, and read-error recovery in the renderer.

features.name: native-chat-coloring
features.purpose: Colors native-chat tool calls with category glyphs and dots instead of monochrome text, and keeps the rich markdown editor's code-block token colors on the shared palette.

features.name: terminal-dock
features.purpose: Docks a rich agent composer beneath a terminal pane running a supported coding-agent CLI, so a prompt can be composed and sent without typing into the TUI, with the terminal still visible as a fallback.

features.name: agent-composer
features.purpose: A host-agnostic composer core extracted from the native-chat composer, so the same draft, history, attachment, and tiered-send behavior serves both the chat pane and the terminal dock.

features.name: native-chat-session-options
features.purpose: Pre-fills the composer's model and effort from agent session logs, and re-reads Claude's startup frame as it paints when no log value exists.

features.name: live-plugin-marketplaces
features.purpose: Points the skill picker at a directory-sourced marketplace's live plugin directory, the one the Claude Code harness loads, instead of the frozen cache copy that goes stale between `claude plugin update` runs.

features.name: skill-plugin-attribution
features.purpose: Attributes each discovered skill to the plugin that owns it, so the composer's skill picker can name the plugin and disambiguate a skill offered by more than one.

features.name: session-handoff
features.purpose: Customizable Continue-in-New-Session handoff with a rich editable brief, target-worktree selection, host-aware warnings, delivery recovery, and one-hop session lineage.

features.name: dirty-branch-indicator
features.purpose: Marks the right sidebar's Source Control tab while the active worktree has uncommitted changes, so a dirty branch is visible without opening the panel.

features.name: artifact-passwords
features.purpose: Encrypts shared artifact content before upload and manages local passphrases and protection lifecycle.

features.name: session-info
features.purpose: Shows provider-neutral details, live context, usage, diagnostics, and safe actions for the exact focused agent terminal session while preserving user-owned statuslines.

features.name: sidebar-section-separator
features.purpose: Draws a hairline between top-level sidebar sections, behind a user setting.

features.name: ask-question-tool
features.purpose: Lets an agent pause a session to ask the user a structured question and blocks re-asking through Claude's own chat surface once a compatible CLI is available.

features.name: workspace-activity-window
features.purpose: Adds a persisted workspace activity-window filter, activity-aware folder visibility, and hidden-count feedback to the workspace sidebar.

features.name: workspace-review-filters
features.purpose: Adds persisted workspace review filters for completed pull requests and passing checks across sidebar and workspace views.

features.name: project-ledger
features.purpose: Records typed project and group engineering observations (bug, deferred item, test gap, proposal, decision) in a durable profile-side ledger reachable from the CLI, the desktop UI, and the local and remote runtimes.

features.name: worker-takeover-gate
features.purpose: Gates the worker-terminal takeover report on real keyboard/IME/paste input, never mouse or scroll.

features.name: skills-repository
features.purpose: Points `npx skills add` at this fork's repository so the skills it ships that upstream does not have are actually installable.

features.name: release-recovery
features.purpose: Covers fork release automation that recovers interrupted RC cuts by resuming only current, complete draft releases.

features.name: fork-sync-precheck
features.purpose: Precheck that lets the daily sync automation skip days with no upstream stable release and nothing to release.

features.name: fork-sync-gate
features.purpose: Local checks and a CI wait that let the sync skill find what PR CI would reject before pushing, and drive the PR from one background command.

features.name: fork-ownership-guard
features.purpose: Teaches upstream's PR aggregate-gate tests that the fork's ownership guard is an ungated job required by verify.

features.name: computer-peer-identity
features.purpose: Authorizes the packaged fork's macOS computer-use peer without broadening bundle-prefix trust.

features.name: release-routing
features.purpose: Keeps stable and RC release notes and build selection on the fork's release repository.

features.name: dev-tcc
features.purpose: Keeps TCC prompt attribution aligned with the stable app and helper bundle identities emitted by the dev runner.

features.name: input-quarantine
features.purpose: Prevents stale terminal and native-chat input from reaching a replacement PTY after reattachment.

features.name: automation-launch-settings
features.purpose: Carries structured model, effort, and agent-argument overrides from automations and source-control recipes into agent launches.

features.name: fork-benchmark-baseline
features.purpose: Lets the advisory PR benchmarks report a script with no baseline commit instead of failing, and keeps the mobile web bundle across timed smoke runs.

features.name: fork-loops
features.purpose: Runs an agent harness repeatedly in a worktree until a check command or evaluator says the work is done, with a rail, setup dialog, CLI, and mobile label.
